text_blocks.snippet: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends several strategies to prevent the spread of COVID-19, including vaccination, masking, and social distancing. Testing is also advised, especially if you have symptoms or have been exposed, to determine appropriate next steps like treatment or isolation. The CDC is also updating COVID-19 vaccine recommendations for different populations.
